haiku-low.q1: The old engine charges and writes the ledger. The new engine's output goes only to the shadow store, without charging.
haiku-low.q2: The new engine charges and writes the ledger. The old engine keeps computing every invoice into the shadow store without charging.
haiku-low.q3: A person must approve. The gate is 7 consecutive days with mismatch rate under 0.1% and at least 5,000 invoices compared.
haiku-low.q4: Automatic rollback starts when the new engine's charge failure rate exceeds 2% in any 10-minute window, in both or new_only. Shadow never triggers it.
haiku-low.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only with gates reset, after all steps verify. What the new engine needs to take over again is NOT STATED.
haiku-low.q6: Rollback from new_only is possible only before day 35. After that the old engine skips events that expire from the 35-day log, so it cannot catch up.
haiku-low.q7: Workers read billing_mode from the config service before charging, and stop charging with an alert if unreadable. How changes reach workers, and in-flight invoices, are NOT STATED.
haiku-low.q8: Evidence is kept in the nightly gate evidence rows, with the transition log proposed. The move is refused and the mode stays shadow if the gate is unmet.
haiku-low.q9: The component is NOT STATED. It measures new-engine charge failure rate above 2% in any 10-minute window, and starts the rollback automatically.
haiku-low.q10: Freeze halts new-engine charges. Queued due charges go to the old engine in Resolve. Due-and-uncharged periods are charged by the old engine at ChargeDue, after CatchUp.
haiku-low.q11: The ledger enforces one idempotency key per customer and billing period, which both engines send to the provider. Reconcile also marks charged periods as never charged again.
haiku-low.q12: Billing stays in RollingBack. The failed step is retried from the same point and on-call is paged. The rollout cannot advance or abort back to both.

sonnet.q1: The old engine charges and writes the ledger. The new engine's invoices go to the shadow store only (no charging, no ledger writes).
sonnet.q2: The new engine charges and writes the ledger. The old engine keeps computing every invoice into the shadow store without charging, so it stays current and the comparison continues.
sonnet.q3: Gate: 7 consecutive days with mismatch rate under 0.1% and at least 5,000 invoices compared. A person approves the move.
sonnet.q4: Automatic: the new engine's charge failure rate above 2% in any 10-minute window. It applies in both and new_only (not shadow).
sonnet.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only, with gates reset. To take over again, the rollout must go forward again step by step: the 7-day shadow count and 14-day both count start over and gates must be met again, with a person approving each move.
sonnet.q6: Rollback closes at day 35 of new_only (the NewOnlyNoReturn state). The old engine skips usage events in new_only and the usage event log keeps them only 35 days, so after that they expire and can't be reprocessed.
sonnet.q8: Evidence is kept in the gate evidence rows (nightly per-day comparison rows: invoices compared, mismatches, rate) and the transition log. A move whose gate isn't met is refused and the mode stays; the gate is checked at the move, and a person must approve.
sonnet.q9: NOT STATED. The document gives the condition (new engine charge failure rate above 2% in any 10-minute window, in both or new_only) and that it starts an automatic rollback, but does not name the detecting component.
sonnet.q10: Due charges still queued go to the old engine unchanged. They are charged in the ChargeDue step, after CatchUp: the old engine charges only the due and uncharged set. If the config service is unavailable, due charges queue and are not dropped.
sonnet.q11: The idempotency key (one per customer and billing period), enforced by the ledger and sent by both engines to the payment provider. Also, Resolve queries the provider to settle uncertain charges, and Reconcile classes charged periods as never charged again; ChargeDue charges only due-and-uncharged ones.
sonnet.q12: The rollout stays in RollingBack (it can't move forward or abort back to both). The step is retried from the same point (steps are idempotent), and on-call is paged.
